result.reason: The operative language gives Customer a convenience-termination right on at least one month's written notice, eliminates early-termination charges, and requires a pro-rata refund of prepaid charges. Although termination remains limited to calendar month-end and therefore may take longer than exactly 30 days, it is no less favorable than the fallback notice range. The redline changes only the payment consequences, preserves the attachment and prerequisite limitations, and does not add any Vendor convenience-termination right. The drafting is clear and professional.
